_meta.description: Per-(msb, pi) slot excludes for quadruped chrs (locomotion=3). Quadrupeds in NR/ER's engine sample a wider footprint at spawn-time pathfinding than bipeds — body extends further forward/back from the anchor point. A slot that's on-mesh by biped classification can still fail quadruped spawn validation if the surrounding walkable area is sparse, even when the spawn point itself is valid. This catalog records empirically-observed quadruped-unsafe slots so the picker can route quadruped chrs (Wolves, Rats, Giant Ants, Horses, Tree Sentinels, etc.) away from them.
_meta.tagging_unit: (msb, pi) — a single Part slot in a single MSB. Adds are per-slot, not per-MSB.
_meta.scope: Applies to ALL chrs with locomotion=3. Whether finer-grained (per-anim-class) distinctions are needed (e.g., 'quadruped is safe but quadruped_large is not') is an open question; refine when we have data.
_meta.maintained_by: manual — entries added as freezes are reported in playtests

These have discovery_method='prophylactic_density_scan' to distinguish from empirically-observed entries.

reposition_proposed.rationale: Sibling pi=0 has highest navmesh density in m45_01 (n10=111 vs pi=3's 79). 4.22m away, a 2.0m shift toward it lands at 2.23m XZ from pi=0 — safe spacing, well outside collision threshold. Likely-denser navmesh at new position; quadruped spawn footprint should validate.
reposition_proposed._verification_protocol: When playtest confirms a quadruped (Rat/Wolf/Giant Ant) spawns and ambulates correctly at this slot's new position, flip playtest_verified to true. The picker gate (gate 4 in _reject_target_for_slot) reads this flag — when true, quadruped targets are no longer rejected at this slot.

slots.notes: First confirmed quadruped freeze. Rat (c4080, loco=3) replaced Wandering Noble (c4300, loco=0) at the roadside_thieves_camp starting encampment. Slot had the lowest navmesh density of any pi in m45_01 (n10=79 vs 80-145 for siblings) and the classifier called it on_mesh, so build_slot_repositions proposed no fix. Hypothesis: quadruped spawn-time pathfinding samples a wider radius than biped; in a sparse navmesh region the wider sample falls into a gap and the entity stalls. Confirms Alaric's hypothesis that quadrupeds need denser navmesh. v0.24.32 adds a reposition proposal (shifted 2m toward dense-navmesh pi=0) — see reposition_proposed field. Gate remains active until playtest verifies the new position is quadruped-safe.

reposition_proposed.rationale: Sibling pi=3 has n10=101 (densest in MSB). Current slot n10=56 (similar to or below m45_01 pi=3 at n10=79). Prophylactic shift to escape sparse-navmesh edge.
reposition_proposed._verification_protocol: Prophylactic addition based on m45_01 pi=3 hypothesis. Playtest to confirm quadrupeds spawn cleanly at the new position. If quadrupeds work AT THE ORIGINAL position too (hypothesis was over-broad), this entry can be removed from the catalog — slot doesn't need protection. If quadrupeds work at new position only, flip playtest_verified=true to release the gate. Lower priority than empirically-observed freezes.

reposition_proposed.rationale: Slot is the sparsest in m43_02 (n10=34, 35% of MSB max 97). Significantly sparser than m45_01 pi=3 (n10=79) in absolute terms but m43_02 has a lower MSB-wide n10 ceiling. Position (0.99, 1.76, 13.19) is an outlier ~17m from the main cluster (pi=1/2 at z≈-3 to -6). Shift 2m toward pi=2 (n10=97, densest with valid position; pi=3 and pi=5 have origin-sentinel y=-37.77 indicating script-spawn placeholders, excluded as shift targets). 14m+ from pi=1 and 17m+ from pi=2 after shift.

v0.24.54: Red Wolf c3181 (anim=quadruped, loco=5) froze here. Slot's existing per-chr position_shift system has been trying (0, +0.5, -5) for c3181/c5820 since v0.24.18 — playtest seed 714653 confirms the shift is NOT sufficient: c3181 still freezes. Per the spoiler position_shift escalation plan ('PROBLEM_SLOTS no-quadrupeds'), gating quadrupeds entirely.

Distinct from the default V3_QUADRUPED_UNSAFE_SLOTS loco=3 criterion: c3181 is loco=5. The slot's failure mode is 'humanoid bipedal spawn point, quadrupeds freeze with navmesh-edge pathlock' (from the position_shift note), affecting all quadrupeds regardless of locomotion bucket. reject_anim_classes=['quadruped'] makes the rejection anim_class-based for this specific slot.

The pre-existing per-chr position_shift entry for c3181/c5820 at this slot can be left in place — it's a no-op now since Gate 4 rejects these chrs before the shift would apply.

v0.24.59: c6060 Goat (anim=quadruped, loco=0, size=S) froze here. Wandering Noble starting encampment slot — humanoid bipedal vanilla, tight camp cluster geometry, quadruped pathing fails. Same failure mode as m46_77 pi=8 / m45_01 pi=3 (humanoid vanilla + sparse-or-tight nav around spawn). loco=0 (not the default V3_QUADRUPED_UNSAFE_SLOTS loco=3 criterion), so reject_anim_classes=['quadruped'] is required to catch this and other anim_class=quadruped chrs regardless of locomotion. Note: NR's in-game UI calls a c6060 variant 'Lightning Ram' (per user report); mechanically still c6060.

v0.24.59: c6031 Bear (anim=quadruped_large, loco=0, size=M) froze here. Companion to pi=2 in same encampment (m43_01_00_00.msb 'wandering_noble_camp'). Same humanoid-vanilla / tight-camp / quadruped-pathing-fails pattern. reject_anim_classes=['quadruped'] uses prefix match — catches both 'quadruped' (Goat) and 'quadruped_large' (Bear, Runebear, etc.). CARRY-FORWARD: m43_01 pi=0 (c2041 Larva of Rot, quadruped_large) and pi=8 (c4165 Bloodbane Stray, quadruped) in this same seed are also quadrupeds at humanoid-vanilla slots in the same encampment cluster, likely to freeze too but not playtested. Add preemptively if next playtest reports more m43_01 freezes; otherwise leave for evidence-driven escalation.
